:::{#thm-mahalanobis-eigen}
#### Mahalanobis distance in eigenvector coordinates

Let $\matr{\covmat}$ be positive definite, with
[eigendecomposition](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-special-matrices.html#def-eigendecomposition)
$\matr{\covmat} = \matr{Q}\matr{\Eigvals}\tp{\matr{Q}}$,
where $\matr{Q}$ has columns $\vecf{q}_1, \ldots, \vecf{q}_p$
and $\matr{\Eigvals}$ has diagonal elements $\eigval_1, \ldots, \eigval_p$.
Then:

$$
\mahal(\vx)^2 = \sumip \frac{\paren{\tp{\vecf{q}_i}(\vx - \vecf{\mean})}^2}{\eigval_i}
$$

:::

::: proof

Let $\vecf{y} = \tp{\matr{Q}}(\vx - \vecf{\mean})$,
whose $i$-th element is $y_i = \tp{\vecf{q}_i}(\vx - \vecf{\mean})$.
By the [inverse of a positive definite matrix](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-special-matrices.html#thm-pd-inverse),
$\matr{\covmat}^{-1} = \matr{Q}\matr{\Eigvals}^{-1}\tp{\matr{Q}}$,
with every $\eigval_i > 0$. So:

$$
\ba
\mahal(\vx)^2
&= \tp{(\vx - \vecf{\mean})} \matr{Q}\matr{\Eigvals}^{-1}\tp{\matr{Q}} (\vx - \vecf{\mean})
&& \text{(definition; substitute } \matr{\covmat}^{-1} \text{)} \\
&= \tp{\vecf{y}} \matr{\Eigvals}^{-1} \vecf{y}
&& \text{(} \tp{(\vx - \vecf{\mean})}\matr{Q} = \tp{\vecf{y}} \text{)} \\
&= \sumip \frac{y_i^2}{\eigval_i}
&& \text{(} \matr{\Eigvals}^{-1} \text{ is diagonal)}
\ea
$$

:::
